request.description: Every recorded value, newest first, including superseded and stale ones. Facts are never edited: a correction is a new fact. Paginate with `cursor` = `nextCursor`. Staff only. Reading needs party read access (ops lead, compliance, support); recording needs party update access (ops lead, super admin). `partyId` comes from a lead or user record.
